name: @singularity/plugin-upstream
description: The repo this checkout was cloned from, watched: one definition of how far behind local `main` is, a daily main-only job that records new upstream commits as a single rolling report (bell + Debug → Reports, whose Investigate mints a merge task), and the Upstream merges automation (off by default; daily once on, configurable) that files one auto-started task merging them with `./singularity upstream merge`, landed only as far as its Push setting allows (never, by default).
